story_theme_en: Durian costs 125 baht per kilogram. If you buy 4 kilograms, how much do you pay? If you have 1,000 baht, how many kilograms of durian can you buy?
helper_tip: Rule of Three: if 1 unit costs X baht, then N units cost N × X.
hint_th: ถ้าสินค้า 1 หน่วย ราคา X บาท สินค้า N หน่วย ราคา = N × X

visual_blocks.title: Think
visual_blocks.content: Cost of 4 kg = 4 × 125 = 500 baht | With 1,000 baht, can buy = 1,000 ÷ 125 = 8 kilograms
